Asset type: transparent 2D MapleStory style pixel game prop, small inflatable round kiddie swimming pool, full pool layer.
Primary request: Draw a tiny round inflatable swimming pool for a small yellow duck pet to sit inside and drink a coconut. The input is only the duck style reference, DO NOT draw any duck, coconut, straw or character in this prop.
Style: authentic clean low-resolution MapleStory item pixel art matching the supplied original duck. Sharp stepped dark brown/navy outlines, discrete pixel blocks, simple 3-tone shading, no vector smoothness or painted gradients. Cheerful pale cyan and white inflatable round pool filled with shallow blue water. Two stacked inflatable sidewall rings, small white highlight pixels on water. Circular ground footprint seen as a shallow ellipse in side view, low front wall so a duck's lower body can later sit behind it.
Composition: square transparent canvas 1024x1024 representing a 128x128 logical pixel grid enlarged 8x. Pool centered horizontally; exact opaque bounds roughly x=160..864 and y=448..824. Top rim ellipse spans x=160..864,y=448..664; bottom floor base ends at y=824. Keep whole surrounding canvas truly transparent. Pool opening empty and broad. Full pool only, no scenery, no title, no text, no shadow outside object. This will be placed behind an existing duck sprite. No blurred or antialiased outlines, no glow.
